heatmap-view.description: Weekly attendance grid by weekday and class period — intensity follows the primary token, empty periods stay neutral, and every cell is keyboard-focusable.

examples.note: Select cells in the log below; periods with no class show a dash.
examples.keyboardNote: Cells are keyboard-focusable: Tab to a cell, arrows to move across days and periods, Enter to select.

scale.note: With showScale the chart paints a segmented intensity bar in 5 buckets (0–20, 20–40, 40–60, 60–80, 80–100) below the grid; this matrix mixes strong and weak weeks, including values near 0, with a few unscheduled periods.

empty.note: With no plottable data, the chart hides the SVG and renders a localized empty message instead of an empty grid.

size-density.note: Size and density combine into a 3×3 matrix: sm compacts labels and canvas, lg expands them, md is the default. Density refines gaps and stroke weight.

installation.note: Install the package and import the standalone heatmap component.

props.note: Inputs, possible values and defaults. The cellSelect output emits the selected row and column.
